about: PROTOCOL 5f.1 sentence reader cases (v3 findings and priority; 5f.6: no question card, q = -1, the closing is B's), written by core/tests/test_oracle_reader --write-fixtures from core/src/oracle_reader.c. Bundles: reader-<bundle>.txt in this directory (fr/en = the real bundles, maintained as checked-in text, synth = the v2 sections with a known table, synth3 = synth with every v3 and short-reading section, long = synth3 with padded findings for the 900-byte budget, nocentre = synth without the centre-gaze sections: with them a facing pair is always covered by the centre gaze). Each case: cards A B C (q is always -1), the expected paragraph text (UTF-8, bytes long, <= 900), the sections of its sentences in order and the budget steps taken. invalid: rows the composer must refuse. Format: core/README.md 'Sentence reader'.

La Force rencontre Le Soleil : l'instinct apprivoisé trouve un soleil pour qui briller. Le regard tourné vers l'avenir, La Force interroge la construction neuve, la chaleur partagée. Dos à dos, La Papesse et La Force regardent ailleurs : quelque chose ne se dit pas. Additionnés, La Papesse et Le Soleil donnent vingt et un : ce qui couvait à l'ombre mûrit au soleil. La Force précède La Papesse dans l'échelle des degrés, mais vient après dans le tirage : l'énergie recule d'une marche. Le chemin descend puis remonte : Instinct en profondeur est le creux d'où l'énergie repart. La Force, l'énergie animale qui s'éveille, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'une préparation en silence, et l'énergie t'emmène vers une construction à deux. Ta force n'est pas contre toi : elle est toi.

Strength meets The Sun: tamed instinct finds a sun to shine for. Turned towards the future, Strength questions new construction, shared warmth. Back to back, The Popess and Strength look elsewhere: something is going unsaid. Added together, The Popess and The Sun give twenty-one: what brooded in the shade ripens in the sun. Strength comes before The Popess on the ladder of degrees, but after it in the row: the energy steps back a stair. The path dips and climbs again (II, XI, XVIIII): Instinct in depth is the hollow the energy starts back from. The three numbers added lead to The Pope: that is what works underneath, without showing itself. Strength, animal energy waking up, holds the middle. You arrive from a long preparation in silence, and the energy carries you towards building together. Your strength isn't against you: it is you.

You come from a surge that has no shape yet; the next step goes towards a chosen beginning. Your strength isn't against you: it is you.

Laisse fleurir ; la forme a le temps.

L'Hermite puis L'Étoile : le sage, revenu de tout, se repose au bord de la source. L'Hermite se tourne vers ce qui précède : la suspension, le don de soi, l'arrêt fécond. L'Hermite et Le Pendu font vingt et un : la longue recherche et l'abandon total se rejoignent dans un même non-savoir. Montée puis descente (XII, VIIII, XVII) : Suspension en profondeur, le sommet Sagesse, puis Générosité en profondeur. Compte les trois nombres : ils te montrent La Force. Ce que cette carte dit reste sous la surface, mais agit. L'Étoile avance derrière L'Hermite : un même élan, deux étapes. L'Hermite, la crise opportune, la sagesse solitaire, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'une longue immobilité, et l'énergie t'emmène vers ta place, ce que tu donnes. Entre deux mondes, ta lanterne suffit.

Le Pendu lève les yeux vers toi : Suspension te concerne, toi. Le deuxième degré deux fois, La Papesse et Le Pendu : accumuler dehors, attendre dedans, et laisser mûrir. Une halte sur le chemin (XVIII, XII, II) : l'énergie se pose avant de reprendre. Compte les trois nombres : ils te montrent Le Pape. Ce que cette carte dit reste sous la surface, mais agit. Le Pendu, la suspension, le don de soi, l'arrêt fécond, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'une nuit d'inquiétude ou de rêve, et l'énergie t'emmène vers une étude, une attente. Ne rien faire est aussi un travail.

De face, Le Diable te prend à témoin : Tentation est ton affaire aujourd'hui. La Maison Dieu puis Le Diable : après l'éclat, l'énergie redescend et s'attache ; une grande passion, ou un lien difficile à défaire. Le degré le plus bas est au milieu (XV) : entre Libération en profondeur et Équilibre, on repasse par Tentation en profondeur. Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : Le Pendu, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. Ce qui se répète a un sens : la couronne, le pouvoir et l'esprit. Le Diable tient le centre, les profondeurs, la passion, la tentation. Tu pars d'un cadre devenu trop étroit ; devant toi, le chemin va vers l'équilibre, le nécessaire. Ce qui te lie peut aussi te nourrir, si tu le regardes.

La Papesse tourne le regard en arrière, vers la réalisation totale, le monde accompli. La Papesse et L'Arcane sans nom ne se voient pas : chaque carte suit sa direction, à toi de les relier. La Papesse prépare L'Arcane sans nom, le degré suivant : Gestation, puis Mutation, dans l'ordre même du Tarot. Le creux est au centre (XXI, II, XIII) : avant Mutation en profondeur, il faut revenir à Gestation. Le Monde au début : l'accompli placé avant le chemin enferme ; la question est de savoir où tu te sens à l'étroit. La carte cachée du tirage est L'Hermite : Sagesse. La somme des trois révèle ce qui agit en profondeur. La Papesse tient le centre, la gestation silencieuse, le savoir qui couve. Tu pars d'un accomplissement entier ; devant toi, le chemin va vers une mutation, un nettoyage. Ce qui couve en toi a son heure pour naître.

Le Soleil te fixe : Construction, ici et maintenant. Un pas vers le bas : après Le Jugement, Le Soleil. Parfois il faut reculer d'un degré pour mieux repartir. Les degrés descendent vers la racine (XX, XVIIII, VII) : Appel en profondeur, Construction en profondeur, puis Action. La carte cachée du tirage est La Roue de Fortune : Fin de cycle. La somme des trois révèle ce qui agit en profondeur. Regarde ce qui se répète dans le tirage : l'enfant, ce qui naît. Au centre, Le Soleil, la construction neuve, la chaleur partagée. Tu viens d'un appel longtemps ignoré, tu vas vers l'action, le départ. Ce que l'amour bâtit peut durer.

Le Jugement lève les yeux vers toi : Appel te concerne, toi. Le Jugement puis La Force : le dixième degré passe la main au premier ; un cycle finit, un autre commence avec une force neuve. Tout monte vers Appel en profondeur (XVII, XX, XI) : Générosité en profondeur y mène, Instinct en profondeur en découle. Les trois nombres additionnés désignent Le Pendu : voilà ce qui travaille en dessous, sans se montrer. L'Étoile regarde hors du tirage, vers la gauche : quelque chose d'antérieur agit encore. D'où vient tout cela ? Le Jugement, l'appel, la naissance d'une conscience neuve, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'un lieu enfin trouvé, et l'énergie t'emmène vers une force créatrice. Réponds : ce qui t'appelle veut naître par toi.

L'Hermite tourne le regard en arrière, vers la fin d'un cycle, la roue arrêtée. Ni L'Hermite ni Le Pape ne cherche l'autre : chacune de ces énergies travaille seule. Les degrés descendent d'une marche entre La Roue de Fortune et L'Hermite : un retour en arrière, à comprendre plutôt qu'à craindre. Les degrés descendent vers la racine (X, VIIII, V) : Fin de cycle, Sagesse, puis Transmission. Le tirage commence avec La Roue de Fortune : ce qui tournait en rond s'arrête, et quelque chose d'autre peut s'ouvrir. Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : L'Amoureux, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. Le centre, c'est L'Hermite : la crise opportune, la sagesse solitaire. Tu viens d'un cycle accompli ; le pas suivant va vers une parole qui relie. Entre deux mondes, ta lanterne suffit.

De face, La Roue de Fortune te prend à témoin : Fin de cycle est ton affaire aujourd'hui. Le dixième degré deux fois, La Roue de Fortune et Le Jugement : ce qui s'achève attend une aide, et l'aide vient d'en haut. Deux cartes au même niveau (XVII, X, XX) : Générosité en profondeur, Fin de cycle, Appel en profondeur, une étape à deux visages. Ici, La Roue de Fortune est une roue immobile sur le chemin : quelle main pourrait la relancer ? Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : La Force, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. La phrase reste ouverte à gauche : L'Étoile se tourne vers un passé que le tirage ne montre pas. Au centre, La Roue de Fortune, la fin d'un cycle, la roue arrêtée. Tu viens d'un lieu enfin trouvé, tu vas vers une renaissance, un appel. Quand tout s'arrête, tends la main.

L'Hermite s'adresse à la carte de gauche, la réalisation totale, le monde accompli : il reste là quelque chose à comprendre. Les degrés montent d'une marche entre L'Hermite et Le Jugement : une croissance, pas un saut. Réalisation, puis Sagesse, puis Appel en profondeur (XXI, VIIII, XX) : la vallée prépare la remontée. Le tirage commence par Le Monde : un œuf encore fermé. Qu'est-ce qui te retient d'en sortir ? Les trois nombres additionnés désignent Le Pape : voilà ce qui travaille en dessous, sans se montrer. Le Monde a les yeux tournés vers ce qui précède la rangée : une origine demande à être reconnue. L'Hermite, la crise opportune, la sagesse solitaire, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'un accomplissement entier, et l'énergie t'emmène vers une renaissance, un appel. Entre deux mondes, ta lanterne suffit.

L'Hermite s'adresse à la carte de gauche, les profondeurs, la passion, la tentation : il reste là quelque chose à comprendre. Chaque carte s'appuie sur la précédente (XV, VIIII, XXI) : Tentation en profondeur, Sagesse, Réalisation. Le tirage s'achève sur Le Monde : ce qui a commencé à gauche trouve sa forme pleine à droite. Les trois nombres réunis redonnent L'Hermite : la carte se désigne deux fois, impossible de passer à côté. Le Monde regarde du même côté que L'Hermite : une carte entraîne l'autre. Le même motif est dessiné plusieurs fois : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. L'Hermite, la crise opportune, la sagesse solitaire, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'un attachement, d'une passion, et l'énergie t'emmène vers la réalisation, le monde. Entre deux mondes, ta lanterne suffit.

Le Mat garde les yeux sur la suspension, le don de soi, l'arrêt fécond : l'avenir appelle déjà. Le chemin descend puis remonte (XVIII, 0, XII) : Énergie libre est le creux d'où l'énergie repart. En marchant vers Le Pendu, l'élan libre lui donne de la vitesse : ce qui s'y joue prend de l'ampleur. Additionne les trois cartes : la somme désigne Le Chariot, l'aspect caché de ce tirage. Le tirage insiste sur un signe, l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Au milieu se tient Le Mat, une énergie libre, en marche sans but fixé. Tu sors d'une nuit d'inquiétude ou de rêve et tu te diriges vers une pause, un regard retourné. Ta force est là, entière ; c'est à toi de lui donner un sens.

Le Pape se tourne vers ce qui vient : une énergie libre, en marche sans but fixé. Le Pape montre le ciel, Le Diable la profondeur : seul, l'un devient utopie, l'autre excès. Deux cartes au même niveau (XV, V, 0) : Tentation en profondeur, Transmission, Énergie libre, une étape à deux visages. En laissant Le Pape derrière lui, le voyageur vide la place : ce qui s'y jouait perd de sa force, ou se libère. Derrière les trois cartes, leur somme fait apparaître L'Amoureux : le fond secret de la question. Le Mat a les yeux tournés vers ce qui vient après la rangée : ce tirage mène plus loin que lui-même. Ce qui se répète a un sens : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Le Pape tient le centre, le pont, l'idéal qui se transmet. Tu pars d'un attachement, d'une passion ; devant toi, le chemin va vers un départ, une libération. Ce que tu as compris ne vit que si tu le transmets.

Le regard tourné vers le passé, L'Empereur interroge l'éclatement joyeux, ce qui sort enfin. L'Empereur et L'Arcane sans nom ne se voient pas : chaque carte suit sa direction, à toi de les relier. Un pas vers le bas : après L'Empereur, L'Arcane sans nom. Parfois il faut reculer d'un degré pour mieux repartir. Un retour aux sources (XVI, IIII, XIII) : Libération en profondeur cède la place à Stabilité, puis à Mutation en profondeur. Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : L'Amoureux, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. L'Arcane sans nom regarde hors du tirage, vers la droite : l'histoire continue au-delà de ces trois cartes. Au centre, L'Empereur, la stabilité, la loi, la puissance du père. Tu viens d'un cadre devenu trop étroit, tu vas vers une mutation, un nettoyage. Bâtis sur ce qui tient, et ne t'y enferme pas.

La Justice d'abord, L'Hermite ensuite : elle cesse de trancher, elle comprend ; il cesse d'errer, il éclaire. Quand La Lune vient d'abord, L'Hermite se perd dans ce qu'il voulait éclairer. La Justice t'interpelle sans détour : Équilibre, ici. La Justice pèse, La Lune reçoit : l'équilibre clair et le mystère de la nuit, deux visages d'une même mère. Le chemin marque un palier (XVIII, VIII, VIIII) : une même étape demande à être vécue deux fois. Additionne les trois cartes : la somme retombe sur La Justice, qui est déjà dans le tirage. Cette carte compte double. La Justice, la perfection réceptive, l'équilibre juste, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'une nuit d'inquiétude ou de rêve, et l'énergie t'emmène vers l'inconnu, une lumière en toi. Garde ce qui te fait du bien ; tranche le reste.

Quand Le Monde vient d'abord, chacun voit dans l'autre son propre empêchement : le voir est un premier pas. Le Diable t'interpelle sans détour : Tentation, ici. Le chemin redescend vers la source (XXI, XV, I) : Réalisation, Tentation en profondeur, Potentiel. Le Monde ouvre la rangée : la réussite est exigée avant même d'agir ; comment sortir de cette coquille ? Additionne les trois cartes : la somme désigne La Roue de Fortune, l'aspect caché de ce tirage. Le Monde regarde hors du tirage, vers la gauche : quelque chose d'antérieur agit encore. D'où vient tout cela ? Un même signe revient de carte en carte : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Au cœur du tirage, Le Diable : les profondeurs, la passion, la tentation. Tu arrives d'un accomplissement entier et tu avances vers un commencement choisi. Ce qui te lie peut aussi te nourrir, si tu le regardes.

Quand La Lune vient d'abord, L'Empereur quitte la terre ferme : c'est elle qui gouverne la maison. Le regard tourné vers le passé, L'Empereur interroge l'intuition, la nuit, le mystère de la mère. Ni L'Empereur ni La Force ne cherche l'autre : chacune de ces énergies travaille seule. Retour au début (XVIII, IIII, XI) : après Réceptivité en profondeur et Stabilité, voici Instinct en profondeur. Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : L'Amoureux, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. La Force regarde hors du tirage, vers la droite : l'histoire continue au-delà de ces trois cartes. Un symbole relie ces cartes : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Au centre, L'Empereur, la stabilité, la loi, la puissance du père. Tu viens d'une nuit d'inquiétude ou de rêve, tu vas vers une force créatrice. Bâtis sur ce qui tient, et ne t'y enferme pas.

La Force précède L'Hermite : l'instinct bouscule le recul, le recul freine l'instinct ; qui peut céder ? L'Hermite regarde d'où tu viens : l'énergie animale qui s'éveille. Le sommet est au centre (VIIII) : Sagesse domine, entre Instinct en profondeur et Guérison en profondeur. Compte les trois nombres : ils te montrent Le Chariot. Ce que cette carte dit reste sous la surface, mais agit. Les deux bords du tirage se tournent vers le centre : une phrase complète, qui contient sa propre réponse. Tempérance avance derrière L'Hermite : un même élan, deux étapes. L'Hermite, la crise opportune, la sagesse solitaire, occupe le centre. Tu arrives d'un instinct tenu en laisse, et l'énergie t'emmène vers la guérison, le juste milieu. Entre deux mondes, ta lanterne suffit.

Le Diable te regarde en face : cette carte te parle directement. Au milieu, le degré le plus haut (XV) : Tentation en profondeur est le point d'où l'on voit tout le tirage. Le voyageur sans numéro marche vers Le Diable et lui apporte toute son énergie : cette carte en est amplifiée. La carte cachée du tirage est La Force : Instinct. La somme des trois révèle ce qui agit en profondeur. Ni Le Mat ni Le Bateleur ne regarde au-dehors : la rangée se referme sur elle-même, rien ne manque. Regarde ce qui se répète dans le tirage : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Au centre, Le Diable, les profondeurs, la passion, la tentation. Tu viens d'un élan encore sans forme, tu vas vers un commencement choisi. Ce qui te lie peut aussi te nourrir, si tu le regardes.

Dans cet ordre, Le Mat et Le Monde se font face : l'élan rencontre le lieu qui l'attendait. De face, Le Diable te prend à témoin : Tentation est ton affaire aujourd'hui. Tout monte (0 à XXI) : Énergie libre se prolonge en Tentation en profondeur et s'accomplit en Réalisation. En dernière place, Le Monde rassemble tout ce qui précède : une œuvre qui peut s'accomplir. Sous la rangée se tient une quatrième carte, invisible : L'Arcane sans nom, que donnent les trois nombres réunis. Ni Le Mat ni Le Monde ne regarde au-dehors : la rangée se referme sur elle-même, rien ne manque. Regarde ce qui se répète dans le tirage : l'animal, la force de l'instinct. Le centre, c'est Le Diable : les profondeurs, la passion, la tentation. Tu viens d'un élan encore sans forme ; le pas suivant va vers la réalisation, le monde. Ce qui te lie peut aussi te nourrir, si tu le regardes.

Le Bateleur se tourne vers ce qui précède : l'éclatement joyeux, ce qui sort enfin. Le sixième degré deux fois, L'Amoureux et La Maison Dieu : la première intervention du ciel, une fois en douceur, une fois en éclat. Le degré ne change pas d'une carte à l'autre (XVI, I, VI) : il faut approfondir avant d'avancer. Les trois nombres additionnés désignent Le Pape : voilà ce qui travaille en dessous, sans se montrer. L'Amoureux avance derrière Le Bateleur : un même élan, deux étapes. Le même motif est dessiné plusieurs fois : la main, ce qu'on saisit ou qu'on lâche. Au cœur du tirage, Le Bateleur : un commencement, tous les outils sur la table. Tu arrives d'un cadre devenu trop étroit et tu avances vers une union, un lien choisi. Choisir, c'est commencer à exister.

The Lover looks back, towards creative explosion, the surge of spring. The path climbs (III, VI, XX): Creation, then Union, then Calling in depth. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up Strength: the secret ground of the question. One symbol links these cards: the angel, help from above. The Lover holds the centre, union, the joy of doing what you love. You set out from an outburst with no clear aim; ahead of you the road leads towards rebirth, a calling. Where your joy is, your road begins.

The World before The Fool: one no longer moves, the other no longer stops. Where is your still part, where your flight? Face on, The Devil calls you as a witness: Temptation is your business today. A return to the source (XXI, XV, 0): Realization gives way to Temptation in depth, then to Free energy. The World at the start: fulfilment placed before the road shuts you in; the question is where you feel cramped. The hidden card of the reading is The Nameless Arcanum: Transformation. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. Through the gaze The World turns to the left, the row opens onto a before: there is still a root to find. The centre is The Devil: the depths, passion, temptation. You come from a fulfilment, a finished work; the next step goes towards a departure, a release. What binds you can feed you too, if you look at it.

Judgement speaks to you plainly: Calling, here. Everything climbs to Calling in depth (XI, XX, XV): Instinct in depth leads up to it, Temptation in depth flows from it. Count the three numbers: they bring you to The Wheel of Fortune. What that card says stays below the surface, but it acts. The reading insists on one sign, the animal, the force of instinct. Judgement, the call, a new consciousness being born, holds the middle. You arrive from an instinct kept on a leash, and the energy carries you towards the creative depths. Answer: what calls you wants to be born through you.

The Magician turns towards what came before: suspension, self-offering, a fertile pause. Between The Hanged Man and The Magician the energy comes down a degree: a movement that lessens, or that returns to the root. Between Suspension in depth and Union the energy plunges (I): Potential is a necessary return. The three numbers added lead to The Sun: that is what works underneath, without showing itself. The Lover looks the same way as The Magician: one draws the other along. One sign returns from card to card: the hand, what is grasped or let go. At the heart of the reading, The Magician: a beginning, every tool on the table. You arrive from a long stillness and move towards a union, a chosen bond. To choose is to begin to exist.

Face on, The Moon calls you as a witness: Receptivity is your business today. Added together, Justice and The Nameless Arcanum give twenty-one: balance accepts transformation, transformation finds its rule. Two cards share a degree (XIII, XVIII, VIII): the energy insists, Transformation in depth, Receptivity in depth, Balance. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Hanged Man: the secret ground of the question. One symbol links these cards: the crown, power and spirit. The centre is The Moon: intuition, night, the mystery of the mother. You come from a break, a grief crossed; the next step goes towards balance, what is needed. What you receive at night lights up the day.

When Strength comes first, new strength and tired wisdom get in each other's way. Strength turns towards what is coming: the opportune crisis, solitary wisdom. The Popess and Strength turn their backs on each other: two energies ignoring each other, or parting. The degrees go down one stair between The Popess and Strength: a step back, to understand rather than to fear. The hollow is in the centre (II, XI, VIIII): before Wisdom, the way comes back to Instinct in depth. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Fool, given by the three numbers together. Through the gaze The Popess turns to the left, the row opens onto a before: there is still a root to find. Strength holds the centre, animal energy waking up. You set out from a long preparation in silence; ahead of you the road leads towards the unknown, inner light. Your strength isn't against you: it is you.

The Star looks steadily at intuition, night, the mystery of the mother: the past still has something to say. The degrees go down one stair between The Moon and The Star: a step back, to understand rather than to fear. Back to the beginning (XVIII, XVII, VI): after Receptivity in depth and Generosity in depth, here is Union. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Pope, given by the three numbers together. The Lover follows The Star with its eyes: Union walks behind Generosity. What repeats has a meaning: water, what flows and is received. The Star holds the centre, giving, generous action from one's rightful place. You set out from a night of worry or of dreams; ahead of you the road leads towards a union, a chosen bond. Pour without counting: earth and water give it back.

Judgement looks at no other card, only at you: Calling is meant for you. Everything climbs to Calling in depth (VI, XX, VIII): Union leads up to it, Balance flows from it. The three numbers added lead to The Chariot: that is what works underneath, without showing itself. The Lover looks out of the reading, to the left: something earlier is still at work. Where does all this come from? One sign returns from card to card: the angel, help from above. Judgement, the call, a new consciousness being born, holds the middle. You arrive from a choice of the heart, and the energy carries you towards balance, what is needed. Answer: what calls you wants to be born through you.

The Hermit steps back towards The Star: his wisdom becomes simple again, as simple as poured water. The Star addresses the card on the left, the opportune crisis, solitary wisdom: there is still something to understand there. The degrees step back (VIIII, XVII, I): not a fall but a fresh start, Wisdom, Generosity in depth, Potential. Add the three cards: the sum falls back on The Hermit, already in the row. That card counts twice. The Hermit has its eyes on what comes before the row: an origin asks to be recognized. The Magician walks behind The Star: one impulse, two stages. The same motif is drawn more than once: the staff, energy in action. At the heart of the reading, The Star: giving, generous action from one's rightful place. You arrive from a world that is ending and move towards a chosen beginning. Pour without counting: earth and water give it back.

The Nameless Arcanum turns towards what is coming: stability, law, the father's power. Neither The World nor The Nameless Arcanum seeks the other: each of these energies works alone. The Emperor comes just after The Nameless Arcanum on the ladder of degrees: what began ripens by a notch. The hollow is in the centre (XXI, XIII, IIII): before Stability, the way comes back to Transformation in depth. In first place The World is not a victory but a hard start: everything seems to have to be perfect at once. The hidden card of the reading is Strength: Instinct. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. The Nameless Arcanum holds the centre, radical mutation, what mows down and renews. You set out from a fulfilment, a finished work; ahead of you the road leads towards a structure that holds. What leaves makes room for the living.

The Hermit looks back, Justice bars his way: wisdom shuts itself up in what it has already understood. Face on, Justice calls you as a witness: Balance is your business today. A return to the source (VIIII, VIII, XV): Wisdom gives way to Balance, then to Temptation in depth. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Pope: the secret ground of the question. Through the gaze The Hermit turns to the left, the row opens onto a before: there is still a root to find. One symbol links these cards: the sword, the clarity that cuts. Justice holds the centre, receptive perfection, true balance. You set out from a world that is ending; ahead of you the road leads towards the creative depths. Keep what does you good; cut away the rest.

The Empress reigns, The Magician gazes open-mouthed: so much brilliance makes him forget his own tools. The Tower looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. Everything peaks with Liberation in depth (XVI), which gathers the energy before it settles into Potential. The hidden card of the reading is Judgement: Calling. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. Notice what repeats in the reading: the crown, power and spirit. In the centre, The Tower, the joyful bursting, what finally comes out. You come from an outburst with no clear aim, you go towards a chosen beginning. When the walls fall, there is room to dance outside.

Turned towards the past, The Lover questions a beginning, every tool on the table. The Magician and Judgement make twenty-one: the seeker meets the call of a new consciousness. Everything climbs (I to XX): Potential carries on into Union and fulfils itself in Calling in depth. The hidden card of the reading is The Hermit: Wisdom. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. The sentence stays open on the left: The Magician turns towards a past the reading doesn't show. Notice what repeats in the reading: the angel, help from above. The centre is The Lover: union, the joy of doing what you love. You come from a first step, still unsure; the next step goes towards rebirth, a calling. Where your joy is, your road begins.

The Emperor then The Moon: the law agrees to listen to the night, and governs differently. The Emperor addresses the card on the left, inner circulation, healing: there is still something to understand there. The Emperor secures the ground, Temperance the heart: alone, one turns authoritarian, the other dreams without footing. A halt on the road (XIIII, IIII, XVIII): the energy settles before it sets off again. Add the three cards: the sum points to The Hermit, the hidden aspect of this reading. Temperance looks out of the reading, to the left: something earlier is still at work. Where does all this come from? At the heart of the reading, The Emperor: stability, law, the father's power. You arrive from making peace with yourself and move towards intuition, the unspoken. Build on what holds, and don't wall yourself in.

When The World comes first, each sees in the other their own obstacle: seeing it is a first step. The Wheel of Fortune looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. When The Wheel of Fortune comes first, gathered experience turns into a first step: everything is to be done again, but you already know something. The degrees fall back to the root (XXI, X, I): Realization, End of cycle, then Potential. Further along the row, The Wheel of Fortune marks a stop: who can turn the crank? The hidden card of the reading is The Pope: Transmission. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. The Wheel of Fortune holds the centre, a cycle at its end, the wheel at rest. You set out from a fulfilment, a finished work; ahead of you the road leads towards a chosen beginning. When everything stops, reach out your hand.

The Chariot looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. The Pope and The Tower make twenty-one: the temple learns joy, and joy becomes sacred. The Tower prepares The Chariot, the next degree: Liberation, then Action, in the Tarot's own order. A summit between two slopes (XVI, VII, V): everything converges on Action. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Wheel of Fortune, given by the three numbers together. The Pope has its eyes on what comes after the row: this reading leads further than itself. What repeats has a meaning: the crown, power and spirit. The centre is The Chariot: action in the world, the journey. You come from a frame grown too narrow; the next step goes towards a word that connects. Move forward, and stay at the centre of your chariot.

Face on, The Sun calls you as a witness: Construction is your business today. Added together, The Magician and Judgement give twenty-one: the quest becomes a rebirth. One step down: after Judgement, The Sun. Sometimes stepping back a degree is the way to set off better. A return to the source (XX, XVIIII, I): Calling in depth gives way to Construction in depth, then to Potential. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Emperor, given by the three numbers together. What repeats has a meaning: the child, what is being born. In the centre, The Sun, new construction, shared warmth. You come from a call long ignored, you go towards a chosen beginning. What love builds can last.

The Magician looks steadily at the call, a new consciousness being born: the past still has something to say. The Magician and Judgement make twenty-one: the seeker meets the call of a new consciousness. After Judgement, everything begins again with The Magician: Calling, and already Potential. A passage through the low ground (XX, I, VI): Potential makes you take things up from their beginning. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Hermit, given by the three numbers together. The Lover follows The Magician: one direction, two energies. One symbol links these cards: the angel, help from above. The Magician holds the centre, a beginning, every tool on the table. You set out from a call long ignored; ahead of you the road leads towards a union, a chosen bond. To choose is to begin to exist.

Justice looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. Back to the beginning (X, VIII, 0): after End of cycle and Balance, here is Free energy. The reading starts with The Wheel of Fortune: what went round in circles stops, and something else can open. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Emperor: the secret ground of the question. The Fool has its eyes on what comes after the row: this reading leads further than itself. Notice what repeats in the reading: the animal, the force of instinct. Justice holds the centre, receptive perfection, true balance. You set out from a completed cycle; ahead of you the road leads towards a departure, a release. Keep what does you good; cut away the rest.

Justice speaks to you plainly: Balance, here. The eighth degree twice, Justice and The Moon: measure outside, intuition within. The path reaches a landing (XVIII, VIII, X): one stage asks to be lived twice. Placed after other cards, The Wheel of Fortune sets a riddle: something is going round in circles, and the answer asks for a new force. Add the three cards: the sum points to The Hermit, the hidden aspect of this reading. The reading insists on one sign, the animal, the force of instinct. In the middle stands Justice, receptive perfection, true balance. You step out from a night of worry or of dreams and head towards a new cycle, with help. Keep what does you good; cut away the rest.

The Tower looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. The degrees fall back to the root (XXI, XVI, XII): Realization, Liberation in depth, then Suspension in depth. The World at the start: fulfilment placed before the road shuts you in; the question is where you feel cramped. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Nameless Arcanum: the secret ground of the question. Through the gaze The World turns to the left, the row opens onto a before: there is still a root to find. One symbol links these cards: the hand, what is grasped or let go. The Tower holds the centre, the joyful bursting, what finally comes out. You set out from a fulfilment, a finished work; ahead of you the road leads towards a pause, a new angle. When the walls fall, there is room to dance outside.

Temperance looks at where you come from: radical mutation, what mows down and renews. In this order the radical impulse calms: the freed energy finds a rhythm and a balance. The degrees rise (XIII, XIIII, XXI): the energy ripens card by card, Transformation in depth, Healing in depth, Realization. The World closes the row: the road goes all the way to its full realization. The three numbers added lead to The Hanged Man: that is what works underneath, without showing itself. Closed on both sides by the gazes, the sentence is enough: look for the answer in the middle. The World walks behind Temperance: one impulse, two stages. One sign returns from card to card: the angel, help from above. At the heart of the reading, Temperance: inner circulation, healing. You arrive from a break, a grief crossed and move towards realization, a wider world. Let it flow between your two vases.

The Fool looks at where you are going: action in the world, the journey. The lowest degree is in the middle (0): between Calling in depth and Action you pass back through Free energy. The unnumbered energy pushes towards The Chariot: the strength of the road comes to feed that card. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Nameless Arcanum: the secret ground of the question. One symbol links these cards: the animal, the force of instinct. The Fool holds the centre, free energy on the move, with no fixed goal. You set out from a call long ignored; ahead of you the road leads towards action and departure. Your strength is here, whole; it is up to you to give it a direction.

When The Sun comes first, The Empress withdraws behind her shield: love turns to possession. Face on, The Empress calls you as a witness: Creation is your business today. Back to the beginning (XVIIII, III, 0): after Construction in depth and Creation, here is Free energy. Just after The Empress, free energy moves away: what that card says is being left behind. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: Justice, given by the three numbers together. The Fool looks out of the reading, to the right: the story goes on beyond these three cards. What repeats has a meaning: the animal, the force of instinct. The Empress holds the centre, creative explosion, the surge of spring. You set out from kinship, a helping hand; ahead of you the road leads towards a departure, a release. Let it flower; the form has time.

Face on, Justice calls you as a witness: Balance is your business today. Everything peaks with Balance (VIII), which gathers the energy before it settles into Free energy. Just after Justice, free energy moves away: what that card says is being left behind. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Wheel of Fortune, given by the three numbers together. The Fool looks out of the reading, to the right: the story goes on beyond these three cards. Notice what repeats in the reading: the crown, power and spirit. The centre is Justice: receptive perfection, true balance. You come from a frame grown too narrow; the next step goes towards a departure, a release. Keep what does you good; cut away the rest.

The Nameless Arcanum looks steadily at a cycle at its end, the wheel at rest: the future is already calling. Transmission, then Transformation in depth, then End of cycle (V, XIII, X): the valley prepares the climb. Placed after other cards, The Wheel of Fortune sets a riddle: something is going round in circles, and the answer asks for a new force. Count the three numbers: they point to The Wheel of Fortune, visible and hidden at once. That is where the reading weighs. The Pope walks behind The Nameless Arcanum: one impulse, two stages. One sign returns from card to card: the crown, power and spirit. At the heart of the reading, The Nameless Arcanum: radical mutation, what mows down and renews. You arrive from a teaching received and move towards a new cycle, with help. What leaves makes room for the living.

The Tower looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. Towards fulfilment (I, XVI, X): Potential opens, Liberation in depth carries, End of cycle completes. Here The Wheel of Fortune is a still wheel on the road: what hand could set it moving? Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Hermit: the secret ground of the question. The sentence stays open on the left: The Magician turns towards a past the reading doesn't show. What repeats has a meaning: the crown, power and spirit. The Tower holds the centre, the joyful bursting, what finally comes out. You set out from a first step, still unsure; ahead of you the road leads towards a new cycle, with help. When the walls fall, there is room to dance outside.

The Sun before Strength: warmth is offered, instinct sulks; behind the resentment, a need for love. Judgement raises its eyes to you: Calling is about you. The degrees climb one stair between The Sun and Judgement: growth, not a leap. The degrees climb and come down again (XVIIII, XX, XI): Construction in depth, the high point Calling in depth, then Instinct in depth. Count the three numbers: they bring you to The Pope. What that card says stays below the surface, but it acts. Through the gaze Strength turns to the right, the row opens onto an after: there is a consequence to watch for. The reading insists on one sign, the child, what is being born. In the middle stands Judgement, the call, a new consciousness being born. You step out from kinship, a helping hand and head towards a creative force. Answer: what calls you wants to be born through you.

The Pope turns towards what is coming: stability, law, the father's power. The degrees go down one stair between The Pope and The Emperor: a step back, to understand rather than to fear. A summit between two slopes (XIII, V, IIII): everything converges on Transmission. Beneath the row stands a fourth, invisible card: The Fool, given by the three numbers together. The Nameless Arcanum looks inwards, and so does The Emperor: the sentence is closed, everything plays out among these three cards. The Nameless Arcanum follows The Pope with its eyes: Transformation walks behind Transmission. What repeats has a meaning: the crown, power and spirit. In the centre, The Pope, the bridge, an ideal being passed on. You come from a break, a grief crossed, you go towards a structure that holds. What you have understood lives only when you pass it on.

Justice looks straight at you: this card speaks to you directly. Added together, Justice and The Nameless Arcanum give twenty-one: balance accepts transformation, transformation finds its rule. Two cards on one level (XIII, VIII, III): Transformation in depth, Balance, Creation, one stage lived under two faces. Behind the three cards, their sum brings up The Lover: the secret ground of the question. One symbol links these cards: the crown, power and spirit. In the centre, Justice, receptive perfection, true balance. You come from a break, a grief crossed, you go towards a creation in bloom. Keep what does you good; cut away the rest.

The Star then The Magician: he thinks he's the source of what she pours; she gently lets him. The Fool turns towards what is coming: a beginning, every tool on the table. Neither The Star nor The Fool seeks the other: each of these energies works alone. The hollow is in the centre (XVII, 0, I): before Potential, the way comes back to Free energy. The unnumbered energy pushes towards The Magician: the strength of the road comes to feed that card. The hidden card of the reading is The Emperor: Stability. The sum of the three reveals what acts in depth. Through the gaze The Star turns to the left, the row opens onto a before: there is still a root to find. In the centre, The Fool, free energy on the move, with no fixed goal. You come from a place found at last, you go towards a chosen beginning. Your strength is here, whole; it is up to you to give it a direction.

The Pope looks towards Justice: teaching leans on measure, and grows more upright. The Hanged Man raises its eyes to you: Suspension is about you. Between Transmission and Balance the energy plunges (XII): Suspension in depth is a necessary return. Count the three numbers: they bring you to The Chariot. What that card says stays below the surface, but it acts. The reading insists on one sign, the crown, power and spirit. In the middle stands The Hanged Man, suspension, self-offering, a fertile pause. You step out from a teaching received and head towards balance, what is needed. Doing nothing is work too.
